key: The shattered glass hurt \PN!
en: The shattered glass hurt \PN!
ja: 砕けたガラスが\PNを　傷つけた!

key: A blade is sheathed in the platform.
en: A blade is sheathed in the platform.
ja: 台座に　剣が　収められている。

key: TAKA: Did you change your mind?
en: TAKA: Did you change your mind?
ja: タカ: 気が　変わったんですか?

key: Go ahead. Take it.
en: Go ahead. Take it.
ja: どうぞ。持って行ってください。

key: TAKA: This is...
en: TAKA: This is...
ja: タカ: これは……

key: I remember now.
en: I remember now.
ja: 思い出しました。

key: My father took me here once, when I was very young.
en: My father took me here once, when I was very young.
ja: 父に　ここへ　連れてこられたことが　あります　まだ　幼い頃に。

key: He told me a story about our family.
en: He told me a story about our family.
ja: 父は　僕らの一族の物語を　話してくれました。

key: A long time ago, Arceus created the world as we know it.
en: A long time ago, Arceus created the world as we know it.
ja: はるか昔　アルセウスは　僕らが知るこの世界を　創造しました。

key: He also had to retroactively create the method for his arrival on that world.
en: He also had to retroactively create the method for his arrival on that world.
ja: そして　自らが　その世界に　到来する方法も　あとから　作り出さなければ　なりませんでした。

key: This was the meteor which our family dedicated themselves and their culture to protecting.
en: This was the meteor which our family dedicated themselves and their culture to protecting.
ja: それが　僕らの一族が　その身と文化を　ささげて　守ってきた　いん石です。

key: But there was another Legendary Pokémon that appeared in Reborn, too--
en: But there was another Legendary Pokémon that appeared in Reborn, too--
ja: ですが　リボーンには　もう一体　伝説のポケモンが　現れました――

key: Giratina.
en: Giratina.
ja: ギラティナです。

key: It appeared here after the world's creation, and its very presence began to distort Arceus' holy ground.
en: It appeared here after the world's creation, and its very presence began to distort Arceus' holy ground.
ja: それは　世界の創造のあと　ここに　現れ　その存在そのものが　アルセウスの聖地を　ゆがめ始めました。

key: So, that Legendary Pokémon became the enemy of our ancestors.
en: So, that Legendary Pokémon became the enemy of our ancestors.
ja: そうして　その伝説のポケモンは　僕らの先祖の　敵と　なったのです。

key: They fought, and they won, and supposedly Giratina left the region forever.
en: They fought, and they won, and supposedly Giratina left the region forever.
ja: 先祖たちは　戦い　勝利し　ギラティナは　この地方を　永遠に　去ったと　されています。

key: But even today, there are many distortions in Reborn that could be said to be caused by Giratina's past influence.
en: But even today, there are many distortions in Reborn that could be said to be caused by Giratina's past influence.
ja: ですが　今日でさえ　リボーンには　ギラティナのかつての影響による　ものだと　言える　ゆがみが　数多く　残っています。

key: This tower...
en: This tower...
ja: この塔は……

key: ...isn't one of them.
en: ...isn't one of them.
ja: ……その一つでは　ありません。

key: I remember my father telling me that our ancestors made this place to train themselves to withstand Giratina's distortions.
en: I remember my father telling me that our ancestors made this place to train themselves to withstand Giratina's distortions.
ja: 父が　言っていたのを　覚えています　先祖たちは　ギラティナのゆがみに　耐えられるよう　自らを　鍛えるために　この場所を　作った　のだと。

key: After the Pokémon's defeat, it became a tradition to climb the Tower.
en: After the Pokémon's defeat, it became a tradition to climb the Tower.
ja: あのポケモンを　倒したあと　この塔を　登ることが　伝統に　なりました。

key: And enshrined at the top was...
en: And enshrined at the top was...
ja: そして　頂上に　まつられていたのは……

key: That.
en: That.
ja: あれです。

key: \PN, go ahead. Take it.
en: \PN, go ahead. Take it.
ja: \PN　どうぞ。持って行ってください。

key: Try to pull it out?
en: Try to pull it out?
ja: 引き抜いてみますか?

key: TAKA: The original weapon that defeated Giratina...
en: TAKA: The original weapon that defeated Giratina...
ja: タカ: ギラティナを　倒した　もともとの武器は……

key: ...is probably not that one.
en: ...is probably not that one.
ja: ……おそらく　それでは　ないでしょう。

key: Who knows if something like that could even still be around by now?
en: Who knows if something like that could even still be around by now?
ja: そんなものが　今も　残っているかどうかすら　わかりません。

key: But at the least, this should be similar.
en: But at the least, this should be similar.
ja: でも　少なくとも　これは　それに　似たものの　はずです。

key: Maybe a descendant, like I am.
en: Maybe a descendant, like I am.
ja: 僕と同じように　子孫にあたる　武器　なのかもしれません。

key: But... I'm not suited to this.
en: But... I'm not suited to this.
ja: でも……　僕には　これは　ふさわしくありません。

key: I may have the slayer's blood in me, but by now, even water must be thicker than it.
en: I may have the slayer's blood in me, but by now, even water must be thicker than it.
ja: 討伐者の血が　僕にも　流れているのかも　しれませんが　今となっては　水のほうが　まだ　濃いくらいでしょう。

key: So whether you end up turning that sword on Giratina or Arceus,
en: So whether you end up turning that sword on Giratina or Arceus,
ja: だから　あなたが　その剣を　ギラティナに　向けるのか　アルセウスに　向けるのか　わかりませんが

key: I want you to take it.
en: I want you to take it.
ja: あなたに　持っていて　ほしいんです。

key: TAKA: Come on, let's get out of here.
en: TAKA: Come on, let's get out of here.
ja: タカ: さあ　ここから　出ましょう。

key: TAKA: What, really?
en: TAKA: What, really?
ja: タカ: え　本当に?

key: All this and you won't even take it?
en: All this and you won't even take it?
ja: これだけの　ことがあって　それでも　受け取らないんですか?

key: TAKA: The text on here is way too faded to read...
en: TAKA: The text on here is way too faded to read...
ja: タカ: ここの文字は　色あせすぎて　読めません……

key: All I can see is something about "being chosen" and "distortion"?
en: All I can see is something about "being chosen" and "distortion"?
ja: かろうじて「選ばれし者」と「ゆがみ」らしき言葉が　見える気が　します?

key: The inscription carved into the stone has faded...
en: The inscription carved into the stone has faded...
ja: 石に　刻まれた銘文は　色あせている……

key: The only legible word reads "chosen".
en: The only legible word reads "chosen".
ja: 読み取れる唯一の言葉は「選ばれし」だ。

key: TAKA: Is... it over?
en: TAKA: Is... it over?
ja: タカ: これで……　終わりですか?

key: This looks like it might be the top.
en: This looks like it might be the top.
ja: ここが　頂上　みたいですね。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
